recognize_zh: 組織中瀰漫成片的多形性淋巴樣細胞，大小不一，從小型到大型、核不規則並可見核仁，細胞之間有粉紅色間質與上皮樣組織球，缺乏特定亞型的結構特徵，是 PTCL, NOS 的典型「多形性混合」外觀。
features: Diffuse effacing infiltrate of lymphoid cells without follicles
Marked cytologic spectrum: small, medium and large cells
Irregular, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei with visible nucleoli in larger cells
Moderate pale to clear cytoplasm in some cells
Admixed histiocytes and eosinophilic stroma; scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies
describe_en: Section shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate composed of small, medium and large cells with irregular, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei and visible nucleoli in the larger cells. Some cells have moderate pale to clear cytoplasm. Admixed histiocytes and eosinophilic stromal strands are present, together with scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies. No follicular architecture or specific pattern is evident. Findings are suggestive of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, pending T-cell immunophenotyping, TFH marker exclusion and TCR gene rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, clear cells and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS).
cHL has rare large Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+ CD15+ PAX5 weak, CD45-) in a reactive background rather than a continuous spectrum of atypical T cells.
THRLBCL has scattered CD20+ large B cells in a bland T-cell and histiocyte background, while small T cells lack atypia.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and frequent ALK positivity.
